jon: I pinged the vendor (Aurora GPUs) this morning. They confirmed hardware availability but shipping + provisioning is ~3 business days unless we do a reserved contract. No cloud quota changes from them.

infra-bot: Quota snapshot for europe-west1

kevin: Autoscaler snippet we used last time — copy/paste into the new pool config:
```hcl
autoscaler {
  target_cpu = 0.7
  min_nodes  = 0
  max_nodes  = 12
}
```
Works with spot/preemptible mix.

jon: I'll open a terraform PR to add the us-west2 spot pool + routing changes. Will @sasha for a quick review, aiming to push in ~20m.
